info.title: UAV PAS Platform API
info.description: API documentation for UAV PAS Platform

tags.name: Training Academy
tags.description: UAV Training & SOP Academy across Customer, Operations, and Admin tiers

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User management, pagination, sorting, and query endpoints

tags.name: Training Courses
tags.description: Course lessons (video, slides, article) and progress

tags.description: Provisioning, password reset, bulk locking and export

get.summary: Stream a training asset (PDF, video, slide or resource) with HTTP Range support

put.summary: Upload training asset bytes via signed backend PUT URL

head.summary: Stream a training asset (PDF, video, slide or resource) with HTTP Range support

put.summary: Update an existing UAV training / SOP document (Admin)
Update user checklist progress and completion status for a document
Save the caller's lesson completion and video position
Set or clear the course cover image (Admin)

get.summary: Get paginated, sorted, and filtered list of users

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size (number of items per page)

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Keyword to search across username, email, or fullName

post.summary: Create an account with a chosen role
Set a new password and revoke the user's sessions
Change the signed-in user's password; all sessions must sign in again
Lock or unlock several accounts
Report a telemetry sample (device key or gateway service account)

get.summary: List UAV training documents and user completion metrics by portal

post.summary: Create a new UAV training / SOP document (Admin)
Create a lesson (Admin)
Register a training upload and get a signed PUT URL (Admin)
Confirm an upload: the stored object must match type and size (Admin)
Generate a lawnmower survey path for a polygon
Start a simulated flight; its telemetry is ingested like a real gateway's
Send PAUSE, RESUME, RETURN_TO_HOME or LAND to a simulated UAV
Start a 1-click digital flight rehearsal for any mission using its assigned or an available UAV
Verify 6-digit Email OTP and issue JWT session
Verify 2FA code (Email OTP or TOTP Authenticator) and issue JWT session
Reset password using 6-digit Email OTP
Resend 6-digit Email OTP for active challenge
Register a new user account
Register account and send 6-digit Email OTP verification code
Refresh access token using refresh token
Logout user and invalidate tokens
User login with username/email and password
Sign in with a Google ID token (creates a customer account for a new email)
Request 6-digit Email OTP for password reset
Sign in with an Apple ID token (creates a customer account for a new email)
Initialize 2FA setup (EMAIL OTP or TOTP QR secret)
Verify code and enable 2FA on current account
Disable 2FA on current account

get.summary: Export the filtered user list as CSV
Get UAV training document detail by code or slug
Lesson player content with signed media URLs
List training courses of a portal with the caller's progress
Course page: overview, checklist and lesson outline by section
All lessons of a course with editable fields (Admin)
Live state of a UAV's simulated flight

delete.summary: End a simulated flight and discard its state

get.summary: List persisted digital flight rehearsal logs

AuthResponse.description: Authentication token response containing access and refresh tokens

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token for obtaining new access tokens

mfaRequired.description: True when OTP or 2FA verification is required before token issuance

mfaMethod.description: Required verification method: EMAIL, TOTP, or EMAIL_VERIFY

challengeToken.description: Opaque challenge token for OTP / 2FA verification

maskedEmail.description: Masked email destination for OTP delivery

devOtpPreview.description: Development-only OTP preview when SMTP is disabled

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token issued at login
Refresh token to revoke upon logout

credential.description: Google ID token returned by Google Identity Services
Apple identity token (RS256 compact JWS) returned by Sign in with Apple

authorizationCode.description: Optional authorization code returned by Sign in with Apple

fullName.description: User full name supplied by Apple on first authorization

nonce.description: Optional raw client nonce to verify against the token nonce claim
